name: proto-blocks/cadco-featured-products
title: Cadco Featured Products
description: A dark-to-light gradient band introducing the catalogue's headline products: an eyebrow, a display heading, then a centre-snapped carousel of product cards carrying the product's own specification bullets, and a closing call to action.

heading.label: Heading
heading.default: Maximize Your Space Without Compromising Performance

backgroundImage.label: Background image
backgroundImage.help: Optional. Sits behind the gradient, which fades from solid black at the top to transparent at the foot — so the photograph reads through the lower half, under the cards.

products.label: Products
products.help: Search by name, then drag to set the order the cards appear in. Leave empty to fall back to every product flagged Featured.

bulletLimit.label: Bullets per card
bulletLimit.help: Taken from the product description's first bullet list — the importer's Supplier Specifications column.

autoplay.label: Advance automatically
autoplay.help: Pauses while the pointer is over the carousel, while a card link has keyboard focus, and while the section is off screen. Stops for good once a visitor scrolls or drags it themselves, and never runs for visitors who ask for reduced motion.
